children: Jersey Mike's Subs Inc. reported second-quarter results for the thirteen weeks ended June 28, 2026, with revenue rising to $208M, up 10% year over year, while net income fell to $37M versus $59M a year earlier.
Revenue: $208M for the thirteen weeks ended June 28, 2026, up from $189M in the year-ago quarter (10% YoY).
Net income: $37M for the thirteen weeks ended June 28, 2026, versus $59M in the year-ago quarter (down 37% YoY).
Diluted earnings per share: Not reported for the quarter — diluted EPS not provided in Part I Items 1–2.
Total revenue growth was driven by net unit expansion of 8.1% and 2.3% same-store sales, contributing to systemwide sales of $1.210B.
Digital sales increased to 43% of systemwide sales; the company changed its delivery strategy and ended advertising fees on third-party delivery markups.
System scale: 3,378 stores across 50 states and Canada with average unit volume of approximately $1.376M.
Unit expansion continued with 83 new store openings in the quarter (130 year-to-date), supporting recurring royalty and advertising revenues.
Operational investments included increased marketing and digital spend and a shift to internal franchise support via Area Director buyouts to support long-term growth.
